items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: Well my very dear friend that took my place when I went with the band as Gina’s conductor was Bill Muncie.

ctx.x: How did he deal with the ever-changing musical tastes?

We did, you know we were doing some Blood, Sweat & Tears things. He always had a good singer too, on the band, a female singer. Really good, except once. That sounds pretty funny. But no, he always had a dynamite singer and he tried to do some modern things. We did like “Traces” and he did “Spinning Wheel” and he did things like that. We spent a lot of time in Vegas because that’s where his home was. And we’d go out — I never really went — he never went out like we did with the Fiftieth Anniversary. We did four…
